slides.texte_overlay: studying all week and still blanking the second i see the test

i stopped memorizing sentences.
now i practice explaining it in my own words.

i mix the questions when i revise.
the test won't ask them in the order of my notes.

i test myself 3 days before, then again the night before.
the second time shows what's really stuck.

when i blank, i breathe and start with the question i'm surest about.
the rest comes back.

no phone in the hour before the test.
my head stays on the subject.
now i walk in knowing i can find it
